preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 10**6 for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Length of each string S is between 1 and 10^6.
Sum of lengths of all strings S does not exceed 10^6.
Each string S consists of lowercase English alphabets only.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(-1 <= line <= len(S) for line, S in zip(output, S_list))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is between -1 and the length of the corresponding string S.
